items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I used to go up to his house every day. And he would go through some stuff... And one time we went to Detroit at the Pontchartrain Hotel.

ctx.x: Eric Dixon, yeah. I’m thinking Eric Dickerson the football player. Eric Dixon had done an arrangement that Dexter Gordon and Hampton had done on that, and boy —
